name: Zoho Mail
description: Sends site email via the Zoho Mail (third-party) API, integrated with Mail System.
project_description:
This module integrates Drupal with Zoho Mail. Zoho Mail is a business email solution that helps you communicate and stay connected with your contacts using a secure email platform. Zoho Mail offers REST API to send emails using Zoho Mail SMTP from your application.

 For more information on Zoho Mail 
 :

Https:// www.zoho.com/mail/ 

 Required 
 Using the Zoho Mail module requires the use of the Mail system module.

 Module installation and configuration 
 Information on installing the Zoho Mail module can be found in this Readme file.

For further queries, contact : support@zohomail.com
